assumptions.note: Order-of-magnitude placeholders for sizing only. Replace by measurement; never used to score the claim.

checks.small_strain: swelling mismatch <= 0.10 (beam theory is linear in small strain)
checks.no_anticlastic: w^2 / (R h) <= 1: wider strips curl across their width and leave the 1-D theory
checks.visible: tip angle L*kappa >= 0.2 rad, and L*kappa <= 2*pi (less than one full turn)
